content: Reyansh Tiwari contacted insurance agent Ramesh Tiwari to inquire about reinstating his health policy with Dcoders. Ramesh informed him that the total amount due is 15,000 INR, including an outstanding premium and a 2,000 INR reinstatement fee. After Reyansh asked about installments, Ramesh offered a payment plan requiring a 50% upfront payment with the remainder split over two months. Reyansh agreed to the plan and inquired about making the payment online.

action_items: Provide online payment instructions to the customer
